tips.text: Bring a room-clearing area weapon; the arena is sealed, so you only fight Regor and his Manics.
Stay on the top floor in phase 3; the flooded middle floor is electrified.
Use a high-status weapon; procs stick through his invulnerable phases and land once he is vulnerable again.
Start each component the moment it drops and farm the second set while the first builds.
Master Equinox before you feed her to the Helminth; players have lost their only copy.
Expect the week-long build chain, not the farm, to be the long part.
